categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan Changlian New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of water-based printing materials primarily for textile printing. Its main product lines include water-based printing pastes, water-based resins, screen printing silicone, digital coating inks, and automated printing equipment. The company also provides integrated printing solutions combining materials, equipment, and processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as new emulsion polymerization, moisturizing technology, dye sublimation prevention, anti-sticking technology, automated integrated machine clean production, digital white paste technology, polyurethane-acrylate copolymerization, and bio-based waterborne materials. It has developed proprietary patented technologies and automated integrated production equipment that enhance product quality, environmental compliance, and production efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves leading global and domestic textile and apparel brands including Adidas, Nike, FILA, Anta, Li Ning, C&A, GAP, Victoria's Secret, Disney, SHEIN, and Yishion. Its products are used in textile printing for clothing, sportswear, underwear, and other fabric applications, targeting both domestic and international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are primarily concentrated in China, with significant domestic market share. The company also exports products internationally, with overseas sales accounting for over 20% of revenue. Key production facilities are located in Dongguan and Huizhou, Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing specialized water-based printing materials and equipment used by downstream textile printing processors and brands. It procures raw chemical materials upstream and supplies finished products and integrated solutions downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment focusing on digital printing pastes, functional pastes, bio-based materials, and automated printing equipment. The company emphasizes innovation through industry-academia collaboration, development of environmentally friendly and high-performance products, and upgrading integrated material-equipment-process solutions to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of water-based printing pastes, resins, silicones, digital inks, and printing equipment. The company operates on a buyout sales model serving both manufacturers and trading customers, with production aligned to customer orders and safety stock strategies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic market position in water-based printing pastes, ranking first in market share in 2020 and 2022 according to Sullivan data. It competes with other chemical and specialty printing material manufacturers but differentiates through patented technologies, integrated solutions, and strong brand customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 553 million, a 4.38% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 70 million, a 15.12% decrease. Total assets grew 47.17% to RMB 1.17 billion, and net assets increased 59.44% to RMB 931 million, reflecting ongoing expansion and capital raising activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly, high-quality water-based printing materials with superior performance such as wash fastness, anti-sticking, and special functional effects. Its integrated 'materials + equipment + process' one-stop solutions improve customer production efficiency, reduce costs, and shorten product development cycles. Patented technologies and certifications like ZDHC and OEKO-TEX ECO PASSPORT reinforce its competitive edge.
